title: Shrink CI image footprint and accelerate builds by migrating to remote CAS and BuildKit cache
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Background: Our monolithic CI images have grown (>1.8GB) and many pipeline stages rebuild similar layers repeatedly. This increases latency, storage costs, and flakiness (timeout-related flakes on longer deps). Goal: modernize the build pipeline by moving to BuildKit with a remote Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) backend, replace large multi-purpose base images with small reproducible distroless/base images, and standardize lint/toolchain upgrade steps.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Average pipeline time for core services reduced by >=25% measured over two weeks. 2) CI worker disk usage reduced by >=40% per-run. 3) All production Docker images reproducibly built with cache hits from remote CAS in at least 90% of runs. 4) Linter/toolchain upgrades validated: Go 1.21, Node 20, hadolint integrated; no timed-out CI runs caused by tool versions.
work_plan: Phase 1: Prototype BuildKit + remote CAS for single repo (runtime-serving). Phase 2: Migrate base images to smaller Debian-slim -> distroless or ubuntu-minimal variants, benchmark size and runtime. Phase 3: Rollout caching across other services, add cache-warm cron, and update runner images. Phase 4: Integrate hadolint in pre-submit and gate, upgrade toolchains and pin versions in hermetic toolchain manifests. Phase 5: Post-migration monitoring and rollback playbooks.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Incompatibilities with current Dockerfiles (multi-stage nuances) — mitigation: add compatibility wrapper and keep legacy builder during canary. Risk: Secrets/credentials leakage to remote CAS — mitigation: restrict CAS to internal VPC, use short-lived tokens and audit logs. Risk: Increased egress costs for CAS — mitigation: estimate bandwidth, enable cross-region preferences and compress layers.
progress_notes: 2025-09-24 - Sofia M: Kickoff meeting with infra and platform; agreed to prototype on runtime-serving; created confluence plan (link below)

2025-09-29 - Arjun P: Completed BuildKit prototype using moby/buildkit with gRPC cache exporter to remote CAS (open-source CAS gateway). Observed 3x cache hit rate on warm runs; first-run latency unchanged.
2025-10-03 - Review: Design review with security (Mei Chen). Action: ensure CAS access restricted to VPC and enable KMS for cached artifacts. Security requested threat model doc.

2025-10-07 - Arjun P: Began Dockerfile refactor on runtime-serving: removed unnecessary apt layers, moved build deps to multi-stage builder, switched final image to distroless base. Image size reduced from 1.9GB -> 370MB in initial run.

2025-10-10 - QA: Found flaky test due to ephemeral file paths in build artifact; added deterministic build args and normalized timestamps. CI job updated to zero-timestamp build to improve reproducibility.
2025-10-12 - Platform: Added experimental cache-warm cron job in staging that pulls latest base layers into runners; saw 45% cache-hit improvement across nightly runs.
2025-10-14 - Arjun P: Opened initial PRs, requested codeowners review; pausing further repo migrations until automated canary rollout and SRE runbook are complete.
